name: spectrum-7b-all-operators
description: Single-job run of all SPECTRUM operators on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, 1 round, MBPP full eval (500 tasks x16), seed 43. Sequential inside one H100 allocation: (1) sweep config = spectral_soft(tau=3) + spd_hard(rank=256) + residual_blend(rho=0.5) sharing one base eval, then (2-5) spectral_soft tau sweep at 1.5/2/5/10. Full tau grid {1,1.5,2,3,5,10}; tau=1 already done in spectral_soft_7b_1round. Mechanism-activation scan to pick the best operator for our spectrum method.
